verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own Batch Processing API for high-volume processing and asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios, so bulk ingestion of customers is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence shows how to track a batch job's progress or resume after a partial failure, and transaction imports are not mentioned. Missing for 10: batch job status tracking, per-record error reporting, resume/retry after partial failure, bulk transaction import, independent corroboration.
